//: Example rpcd ACL for a SCOPED wfm login on a real OpenWrt node. The test harness itself logs in as root (whose default rpcd login already grants everything), so this file is documentation for production: install it at /usr/share/rpcd/acl.d/wfm.json and reference the group from a dedicated `config login` in /etc/config/rpcd (list read wfm / list write wfm).

wfm.description: Minimal access for the wfm wifi manager
